text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And into the home stretch!!
The home stretch of the Japanese Derby!!
Up the hill they charge! Which Umamusume will seize victory!?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOOOOAAHHHHH!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (――Fulfill my duty.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (――Live up to their trust.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (Yes, I swore it. That's why————)
(THUD!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? Are those a giant's footsteps—!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's Symboli Kris S! Symboli Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With an incredible burst of power, Symboli Kris S shoots up the ranks!!
It's Symboli Kris Ssssss!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's done it! Symboli Kris S is victorious!!
Kicking away the fierce rivals of her generation, a majestic triumph!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...This is not the end. It starts from here.
I must stack up even more "results.")

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Onto the next.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: T-That was an amazing race! ...Or it should've been, but—Kris S did win, right? Isn't her reaction a little too subdued...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It was such a great race, though~!
Just a little bit more~! Urrgh...!!
Come on, Japanese Umamusume, give it a little more fight~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Amazing, absolutely incredible!
Unshaken even after victory,
such a majestic and dignified presence...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san really is...
She is the "Hero" that I ought to strive to become...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Splendid. It seems you have defied destiny.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Gimlet――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh hehâ
Those eyes, that running, capable of freezing even frenzy solid...
I have burned them firmly into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "fateful day" came to an end—
and our paths were meant to diverge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (What is this...? For some reason, Gimlet's words aren't getting through to me like usual—)

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet!! That was so close!
Prove you're the strongest next time!!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You were amaziiing!!
I'll never forget that runnn!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gim-senpai...!
You were so close... You must be so frustrated, yet you still look so cool—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Me too... Even I...!
Just like Gim-senpai...!!
I'm definitely gonna become a super cool Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Bwaaa-hahaha! Go mad with bliss!
Bask in the dazzling brilliance of mine, burned into your very eyes!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet!! Lord Gim!!
That was so close!! You're the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(That is... the frenzy Gimlet brought forth.
Gimlet's run has burned itself into their minds—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...Creating such feverish excitement
is surely something I cannot do—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(A sight completely unlike anything of mine...
one that only Gimlet could ever create—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And with this, my curtain falls.
The seeds of the next chaos have been sown, and what arrives is a delightful boredom—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I've done enough.
—What comes 'after' is your era, Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Wait. What... does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
You'll understand in time.

Symboli Kris S returned after winning a fierce battle.
Her demeanor, as always,
remained entirely calm.

However, seeing her remain unchanged like that,
I find myself feeling relieved—
choice_data_list: We managed to leave one big "result" behind.
We managed to leave one big "result" behind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Finally.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I look forward to working with you next time as well.

Delivering "results," and moving on to the next "result."
With an unyielding pace, I resolved
to start anew from here...!
That night—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Autumn, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
Falling leaves beneath a setting sun. Truly fitting for the end.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet the world, and time, only moves forward.
Leaving me behind, along with my memories—"

Unheard by anyone,
those words simply dissolved into the starry sky—
